transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Before we finalize the duty roster for the three uncovered exercise shifts, I need to hear from each of you on a couple of things. First, per our standing Monday personnel-sync routine, the company commanders and S-1 officer need to report any roster changes before I publish the schedule. Second, I'll need each of you to confirm which shift your team can cover and identify a named shift handoff point of contact for that assignment. The three shifts we need to fill are: Tuesday 0600-1400, Wednesday 1400-2200, and Thursday 2200-0600. Alpha, Bravo, and battalion support staff will each take one shift, and no team covers more than one. Let's start with any personnel updates, then work through shift assignments.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to report a roster change: Alpha Company's only currently qualified exercise-cell supervisor is Sgt. Ellis, and he is available only for the Tuesday 0600-1400 shift. He begins an instructor course Tuesday afternoon, so he cannot cover Wednesday or Thursday shifts. I confirmed the course enrollment this morning, but the updated availability is not yet on the battalion roster. This means Alpha Company needs to be assigned the Tuesday 0600-1400 shift, with Sgt. Ellis as our named shift handoff POC.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to report a roster change: Bravo Company's designated cell team must cover the Wednesday 1400-2200 shift. Our communications liaison is scheduled for a certification appointment Thursday morning and cannot support the Thursday overnight handoff. I received the appointment confirmation yesterday, but it has not been added to the exercise staffing worksheet yet. So Bravo Company needs to be assigned the Wednesday 1400-2200 shift.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to report a roster change and a directive constraint. This morning I received a signed higher-headquarters personnel directive requiring the battalion support staff team to cover the Thursday 2200-0600 shift, with the handoff logged to the duty officer. This directive has not yet been posted to the published roster. So the battalion support staff must be assigned Thursday 2200-0600, and we'll need the handoff logged to the duty officer per the directive.
transcript.speaker: A4
